verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents Read Statuses, which are shared across teams so anyone can follow up with context. Its MCP page says it can 'check which emails have been read' and time sends for when each recipient is most likely to open. A community comment independently confirms the product enables this kind of open-tracking of recipients. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-recipient open timestamps (the 'when' part of the story), and first-party docs describing the read-status UI in the individual client.
